column1: # Game profile of Minecraft Dungeons II (Switch, update 1.1.3.0 = v131072 over the base game 1.1.1.0 = v0, with its Hero Pack add-on)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Mojang Studios, Unreal Engine 5.6.1 (SDK MW+EpicGames+UnrealEngine-5_6_1 in main; SF_GLSL_SWITCH shaders in two IoStore shader libraries), SDK 20.5.15, NVN, Wwise sound, Havok.
# Status: provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py from the survey, peanuts/docs/NEW-GAME.md); the note (README.md) says what is a guess

# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. The rewriter cuts the allocator in any Unreal 4 / 5 main (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), so an iPhone takes a smaller guest block, as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/reference/memory.md)
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# 64 vertex shaders (Unreal's particle vertex factories, as in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, the same engine version) pick their texture and sampler slots at run time from c2's tables;
# the translator cannot trace them to one slot, and without the key their draws were skipped ([RED] dynamic texture handles, first run on the Thor 2026-11-23)

# The two shader libraries of the IoStore container Dungeons-Switch.utoc / .ucas (uepak.py; the PC build decodes them with unoodle, DM_OODLE_OOZ): the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
